court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Riverside
case_search_note: Public Portal for Civil, Criminal, Family Law, Probate and other case types (linked from the court's 'Search Court Records—Public Access' page). Court disclaimer: online information is not the official record. The register of actions shows the courtroom/department where a case is heard. The same page links the Sheriff inmate locator.
